column7: It’s difficult to utilize tickets, especially when a schedule is not released prior to purchasing season tickets. It makes it nearly impossible to purchase a group of season tickets because there is just so much unknown.
Ticketmaster has too many fees that i feel like are really unreasonable. Even with resold tickets.
column14: Hope they use a different ticketing agency other than Ticketmaster.

Food and drinks are expensive. Supporters section needs more information widely spread, people break open the locked seats at every game and they don't understand that they purchased GA tix. Away fans have been in the supporters section multiple times.

column7: The discount for additional tickets barely covers fees
column14: Food is overpriced, but there are good choices. The audio is horrible. The announcer/music is completely unintelligible. There were issues keeping people from mobbing players in the supporters section

The supporters section often gets inundated after a game wanting signatures. It is chaotic and people push and can get hurt. Also, there are not clear policies for away fans sitting in supporters section and it can get heated.
Security could do  A better job of responding to incidents. Food is expensive and small portions.

column7: Other than having a regular seat not sure what bandit is off being a STM
column14: Too many questions ask too many questions. Food & drink pretty pricey but water readily available in Club. The way our stadium is set up the Supporters section isn’t loud enough compared to other stadiums (thinking Thorns/Reign, etc). Needs to be miked up!

column7: The benefits haven't been as good as I'd expected, based on the early emails from the front office.
column14: Security could be better. Water stations aren't always there. Parking is too expensive and the attendants sometimes try to prevent us from parking with our Sirens tailgating group for no apparent reason.

column7: Ticket prices are good, if anything, they're too low and we should pay players and staff more! That said, having a big crowd is also very important to the players and experiential appeal, so I don't begrudge the FO having kids-attend-free games, for instance.
